name: @pi-cpp-lsp/claude-code-plugin
description: The cpp-lsp Claude Code plugin: its MCP server, hooks and skills on top of the shared C/C++ core

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.ts src/bin/trust.ts src/bin/setup.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outdir=server --out-extension:.js=.mjs --entry-names=[name] --legal-comments=none --log-level=warning "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);"
